fixes.explanation: Jesus tells Sardis, “you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.” A reputation is what a church is known for, and for Sardis that was being alive. I've seen cookies that looked golden and finished on the cooling rack and turned out raw in the middle, so I know how looks can fool you. Jesus sees past the outside.
